data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'wtf', Itaf signifies the concept of a gift or reward. In Islamic context, it is a reminder of the spiritual blessings and rewards bestowed upon the believers. The name Itaf carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Itaf usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
